description: Shajareh Tayyebeh girls' primary school, Minab, Hormozgan province, Iran. Reported struck three times. Reported ~165-175 killed, predominantly schoolchildren. Condemned by UN human rights experts and UNESCO; a US preliminary investigation reportedly attributed the strike to outdated targeting data. Time of day not established from open reporting at the time of entry — the timestamp is a date placeholder, not an observation.
author: human-curated from open reporting (OHCHR, UNESCO, Al Jazeera, HRW, US congressional correspondence)
